mutants.description: Introduces early return inside comparison loop when first mismatch is detected, violating constant-time execution by terminating early on mismatch
mutants.expected_detection: RTL simulation will show variable cycle counts: fewer cycles when mismatch occurs early versus late in token. Static analysis detects return statement inside loop body.

mutants.description: Replaces bitwise OR accumulation with short-circuit logical OR operator, introducing data-dependent timing variation through early evaluation termination
mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis detects logical OR operator (||) applied to comparison results. Dynamic simulation may show timing variations depending on synthesis tool optimization.

mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis detects if-else branch with condition derived from byte comparison. CFG analysis reveals data-dependent control flow. RTL simulation shows variable cycle counts.

mutants.description: Changes loop bound from constant 16 to variable dependent on accumulated difference, causing variable iteration count based on input data
mutants.expected_detection: Static analysis detects variable loop bound. Simulation instrumentation shows iteration count varies across test cases. RTL synthesis may fail or produce non-constant timing.

mutants.description: Uses ternary operator with secret-dependent condition inside loop to update accumulator, introducing timing variation through conditional data flow
